A '''comm board''' was a type of communications device. The [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Bie Breil'lya]] owned a comm board and in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] Breil'lya was apprehended by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Andov Syn|Nariss Siv Loqesh]] while distracted by a message that he had received via the board.
